version: 26.0 (the TDM HUD in three corners; procedural reload audio per gun)

uicheck.method: node scripts/uicheck.mjs: 4 sizes x 4 screens; overlaps among the minimap, health, callsign, ammo, team board, score and feed
uicheck.result: 16 of 16: no spill, no overlap; smallest text 11.3 px (1440x900) to 18.5 px (4K)

csscheck.label: the TDM HUD (a kill of his in the feed), loop stopped

boardcost.method: node scripts/boardcost.mjs 200: headless, a TDM match with the loop stopped; 200 kills on the board (a bot's kills + 1, every third a death), each followed by a frame; DevTools metrics minus the same 200 idle frames
boardcost.order: rows read by score after the run: 3400 3300 3300 3300 2550 2475 0

hud.live: Neon Docks, 5 forced kills: score ALPHA 5 - 1 OMEGA with tickets alpha 24, omega 20 of 25; board sorted, his row first and gold

reload.method: node scripts/reloadcheck.mjs: each stage rendered offline (OfflineAudioContext 48 kHz, dry, as AudioEngine plays it); length to -40 dB, peak, spectral centroid (2048-pt Hann frames), energy share under 250 Hz. LEAK=1 renders every noise layer started at 0 (as the engine played them before 26.0)

burstLeak.bug: burst() started its noise source now and its gain envelope at t; a GainNode is 1 until its first event, so a burst scheduled ahead played full-level noise until it began
burstLeak.fix: the noise starts at t (13 delayed burst calls in the engine: reloads, gunshot tails, impacts)

mainThreadMsPerCall.note: building and scheduling the nodes; nothing runs after the call
